verdict.rationale: LibreChat is a self-hosted AI platform with an Agent Management API, so shipping its own MCP server is a fair question to ask. All the MCP evidence, however, is client-side: LibreChat connects to external MCP servers and lets users add them at runtime (docs-7, docs-8, docs-24). The probe claiming an 'official MCP server' points to that same client-integration page, so there is no evidence of an official MCP server that external agents can connect to.
